claim.quote: Building on the achievements of the 50 L prototype (LIME), which successfully operated underground at LNGS, the next step is the deployment of a 0.4 m3 demonstrator, CYGNO-04, to be completed in 2026.

name: The CYGNO experiment: a gaseous TPC with optical readout for rare events searches

summary.plain: CYGNO's 50-litre prototype ran successfully for over two years in the Gran Sasso laboratory. The next step is a 0.4 cubic-metre demonstrator, due to be completed in 2026.
summary.technical: LIME underground at LNGS: about 27 months in five shielding configurations (no shielding, 4 cm Cu, 10 cm Cu, 10 cm Cu + 40 cm water, 10 cm Cu); up to ~1.2e7 images; trigger rates from ~34 Hz down to ~1 Hz. A review paper submitted to JINST (preprint).

title: The CYGNO experiment: a gaseous TPC with optical readout for rare events searches
why_it_matters: The abstract says the demonstrator will validate scalability.
